bagPolicy.summary: One small purse or personal bag up to 10" x 6" x 2" is allowed. No backpacks or other bags are allowed.
allowed: Small purse or personal bag up to 10" x 6" x 2"
bagPolicy.note: Exceptions are made for required medical equipment. Binbox lockers, inside and outside the arena, are the only approved bag storage. Additional restrictions may apply on certain event days.

parking.note: Parking availability, access routes, and pricing at United Center can vary by event. Review the linked official information and reserve in advance when that option is offered.

rideshare.note: A dedicated rideshare zone was not confirmed in United Center's current published guidance. Follow the event page and your rideshare app on show day, and use only signed pickup or drop-off areas.

concessions.note: Food and beverage availability at United Center varies by event and operating setup. Review the linked official guest information before arrival.

accessibility.title: ADA & Accessible Services
accessibility.body: 100% ADA compliant. Wheelchair seating on all levels. Elevators near Gates 3 & 7. ADA parking in Lot G off Damen Ave. Sensory Room at Gate 2½. Sensory bags at Guest Relations Gates 2 & 6. Contact: 312-455-4500.

reEntry.title: Re-Entry Policy
reEntry.body: Strict no re-entry for all events.

ticketPickup.title: Will Call
ticketPickup.body: Guest Relations at Gates 2 and 6. Contact: 312-455-4500.

gates.title: Gates & Entrances
gates.body: 6 gates around arena. Elevators near Gates 3 and 7 for accessible access.
